messages.text: What evidence is required to compare our Oscilloscope solution with a competitor for Automotive without making unsupported claims?

A valid Automotive Oscilloscope competitor comparison would need one cited source that directly connects the oscilloscope solution, the Automotive use case, and the competitor comparison; separate mentions of “oscilloscope,” “Automotive,” and a competitor are insufficient for a comparison claim [68].
For our product side, evidence should be Productions-type material such as a datasheet, specification, option list, license list, or product brochure, because Productions data covers product specs, options, licenses, and brochures [23][24].
Any option code, order number, compatibility, dependency, or price must come from the source text and cannot be generated or inferred [26].
For the competitor side, R&S internal battle-card or sales-positioning material is not enough to treat competitor weaknesses, superiority, lower TCO, or “only vendor” statements as technical or market facts [48].
Competitor product claims such as frequency range, bandwidth, data rate, option codes, software tools, and support model require validation from the competitor’s official datasheet, release notes, or support terms [48].
If the Automotive claim is about standards or compliance, the evidence should identify the relevant standard version and test basis; for example, NG eCall evidence in the passages names EN 17240:2024 and says the R&S CMX500 was used to validate NG eCall implementation while simulating a PSAP [2][54].
A compliance or performance comparison would still need full test case IDs, measurement conditions, software versions, or pass/fail reports, because the cited NG eCall source explicitly lacks those details [54].

- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 宣稱其與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 合作，驗證 [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 上 [[Next Generation eCall]]（NG eCall）的 implementation，並稱其符合 [[EN 17240]]:2024。

- 來源指出，隨著 2G / 3G circuit-switched cellular networks 逐漸 obsolete，emergency call systems 需要適配到 4G / 5G packet-switched cellular networks。
- 來源稱 [[European Commission]] 在其 most recent regulation 中定義 NG eCall 將自 **2026-01-01** 起成為 obligatory。
- 來源稱 EN 17240:2024 建立在 IP Multimedia Subsystem（[[IMS]]）networks 上測試 eCall systems 的 guidelines，涵蓋 advanced 4G LTE 與 5G NR technologies。
- [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 被描述為 5G automotive-grade platform，支援 high-speed connectivity、advanced positioning、Vehicle-to-Everything（[[V2X]]）、multi-band [[GNSS]] navigation 與 enhanced safety。
- 來源稱驗證流程使用 [[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester，作為 NG eCall voice and data transmission 的 comprehensive testing solution。
- 來源稱測試模擬 [[PSAP]]，並驗證 implementation at both ends with the [[EN 17240]]:2024 standard。
- 來源說 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援 4G 與 5G technologies，目標是讓方案 future-proof。
- [[Juergen Meyer]] 以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Vice President Market Segment Automotive 身分在新聞稿中引述，稱此次 collaboration 為 future emergency call services 建立 new benchmark。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option 可在 realistic network conditions 下用於 NG eCall testing。
- 來源將合作定位為 mutually validating solutions、reducing effort、accelerating time to market for mutual customers。
- Press and media contact 為 [[Patrizia Muehlbauer]]，職稱 PR Manager Products & Standard Systems。
- 公司資訊段落稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 2024/2025 fiscal year net revenue 為 EUR 3.16 billion，2025-06-30 worldwide employees more than 15,000。

2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient › 重點摘要
這份來源是由 [[Randy Schnell]] 製作 / 主講的 company restricted 簡報，題為 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient；raw frontmatter 顯示原檔為 `2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient.pptx`，轉檔日期為 2026-09-17。來源正文沒有另外標示正式發布日期；本頁以檔名 / raw title 的 2025-12-19 作為來源日期線索。

簡報主張的核心問題是：在不修改 [[DUT]] 的前提下，能否利用 legacy [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]] / [[FHSS]] 能力，讓 unmodified 5G DUT connection 對 [[Smart Jamming]] 更具韌性。

主要內容如下：

- 任務背景：tactical edge connectivity 對資料與低延遲需求提高，[[Smart Jamming]] 與 electronic warfare（[[EW]]）威脅增加，private [[5G]] networks 在 military bases / tactical environments 的採用升高。
- 技術映射：來源將問題映射到 5G handover（[[HO]]）signaling 與 frequency-hopping（[[FH]]）signaling；測試設計需使用 [[UE]] capabilities message 回報的 supported bands，並關注 [[3GPP TS 38.300]] 定義的 handover interruption intervals。
- 測試結果：來源聲稱 both modems showed sufficient performance for running video call；throughput 與 [[WebRTC]] statistics 支撐 video-call reliability 維持，但投影片 OCR 未提供具體 throughput、jitter、packet loss、bandwidth、jammer profile 或 modem 型號數值。
- 現有 defense / Future-G program 脈絡：來源列出 [[5G.MIL]]、[[Raytheon OXYGEN]]、[[L3Harris Tactical Network Demo]]、[[DoD EMS Superiority Strategy]]、[[FutureG ISAC]] / spectrum sharing 等項目，說明 FHSS / frequency-agile operation 與 5G / 6G coexistence 的整合方向。
- 時程展望：來源給出 short term 2025–2028、mid term 2028–2032、long term 2032–2035+ 三段式展望，包含 5G tactical networks scale-out、mmWave phased arrays field testing、5G/6G-capable SD radios、early ISAC for drone detection / perimeter defense、URLLC for autonomy、full 6G with integrated sensing、AI-native battlefield connectivity 與 spectrum-aware autonomy。
- Call to action：重新接觸既有 CMX customers，尤其 DOW customers；與 integrators 溝通；保持 tactical patience；提早 engage BDM organization；跨團隊分享 lessons learned。

- `hybrid`：短物距 `< 17 m` 使用 analog stepped delay line；較長距離至 `3000 m` 使用 fully digital implementation。

- `Typical data (typ.)`、`Nominal values (nom.)`、`Measured values (meas.)` 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。
- `Uncertainties`：coverage factor 為 2，依據 GUM 計算，納入 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。

A valid Automotive Oscilloscope competitor comparison would need one cited source that directly connects the oscilloscope solution, the Automotive use case, and the competitor comparison; separate mentions of “oscilloscope,” “Automotive,” and a competitor are insufficient for a comparison claim [68].
For our product side, evidence should be Productions-type material such as a datasheet, specification, option list, license list, or product brochure, because Productions data covers product specs, options, licenses, and brochures [23][24].
Any option code, order number, compatibility, dependency, or price must come from the source text and cannot be generated or inferred [26].
For the competitor side, R&S internal battle-card or sales-positioning material is not enough to treat competitor weaknesses, superiority, lower TCO, or “only vendor” statements as technical or market facts [48].
Competitor product claims such as frequency range, bandwidth, data rate, option codes, software tools, and support model require validation from the competitor’s official datasheet, release notes, or support terms [48].
If the Automotive claim is about standards or compliance, the evidence should identify the relevant standard version and test basis; for example, NG eCall evidence in the passages names EN 17240:2024 and says the R&S CMX500 was used to validate NG eCall implementation while simulating a PSAP [2][54].
A compliance or performance comparison would still need full test case IDs, measurement conditions, software versions, or pass/fail reports, because the cited NG eCall source explicitly lacks those details [54].
